title: Member Terms: Discounts and the Programme Rebate on a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
Three discounts can land on a crop input invoice and the programme decides how they combine.

**Early pay.** The early pay discount is earned where the invoice is paid in full inside the early pay window, counted in whole calendar days from the invoice date, a payment on the final day of the window still earning it; a part payment earns nothing.

**Volume.** The words that stood here — *"The volume discount is earned on season input spend above the programme's volume threshold, the spend being the member's invoiced amount across every input account for the current crop year, and it is granted at the close of the season rather than invoice by invoice."* — are **no longer in force** on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, having been superseded by the current basis on which the season spend the volume discount is earned on is measured.

**Prepay.** The prepay discount is earned on money booked inside the prepay window and is granted when the booking is taken, not when the product is drawn.

**Combination.** How they combine is fixed by the programme's stacking basis and never negotiated at the counter, and on a best-single basis the largest of the applicable discounts is granted and the others are not.

**Programme rebate.** A programme rebate, where the programme carries one, sits outside the stacking basis and is paid after the season on qualifying spend once the enrolled acres reach the rebate threshold.

**A discount a programme does not carry.** Such a discount is not zero but simply not applicable, so it never appears on the invoice as a nil line.

## The same rules as a table

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Paid in full on the last day of the early pay window | The early pay discount is earned |
| Paid in part inside the window | Nothing is earned |
| Prepay money booked inside the prepay window | The prepay discount is granted when the booking is taken |
| Two discounts applicable, best-single programme | The larger is granted, the other is not |
| The programme carries no early pay rate | The early pay discount is not applicable, and no nil line is written |
| Enrolled acres below the programme's rebate threshold | No programme rebate is paid |

The early pay rate and window, the stacking basis and the rebate threshold are each the figure the member's programme carries on the discount and rebate rate card.

## One calculation

The discount amount granted for early payment on a line is the extended amount of that line multiplied by the programme's early pay rate, rounded to two decimal places. Taking a hypothetical line whose extended amount is 4800.00 USD, and taking the early pay rate the member's programme carries to be 1.5 percent for the illustration, the discount amount granted is 72.00 USD.

superseded_clauses: The volume discount is earned on season input spend above the programme's volume threshold, the spend being the member's invoiced amount across every input account for the current crop year, and it is granted at the close of the season rather than invoice by invoice.
